title: Wreck and Monsoon
premise: Bush pilot Isandro Yarrow crashes on a receding tidewater glacier and discovers a cave exposed by the ice — inside it, a 1920s salvage ship frozen mid-voyage, its manifest promising a fortune in medicine-grade quinine and a letter that could clear his dead father's name as a mutineer. Racing a rival salvage fleet and the six tides before calving season seals the route forever, Isandro gathers an unlikely crew: a disgraced marine archaeologist, a teenage stowaway, and the fleet captain's estranged daughter. He must choose between salvaging the treasure that would save his airstrip and publishing the truth that would damn his father's rescuers. In the end, Isandro sacrifices the cargo to a calving glacier but escapes with the letter, clearing his father's name at last — and finding that the crew who stayed with him through the wreck are the family he never had.
about_author: M. M. Blackwood is the pen name of a former floatplane mechanic who spent a decade flying supplies into coastal Alaskan villages before turning to writing full-time. Their fiction draws on real salvage lore and the unforgiving arithmetic of tide tables, weather windows, and trust.

chapters.title: Freight and Rumors
chapters.summary: Isandro Yarrow flies medicine and gossip into interior villages, barely solvent, haunted by his father's disgrace as the mutineer of the salvage ship Meridian. A dying old-timer pays him in gold dust and a hand-drawn chart marked with a cave. POV Isandro; establishes loneliness and debt, ending on the hook of the chart.

chapters.title: The Tide Gives Back
chapters.summary: Following the chart on a low spring tide, Isandro spots a cave mouth revealed by the retreating glacier — impossible, since his charts show solid ice for a century. He lands against his better judgment. POV Isandro; wonder warring with superstition, closing as he steps into the dark.

chapters.title: What the Ice Kept
chapters.summary: Inside the cave Isandro finds the Meridian herself, flash-frozen mid-sinking, cargo intact — including a sealed letter addressed to his father. Before he can take it, an ice bridge collapses, stranding him. POV Isandro; awe curdling into dread as the route closes behind him.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Trapped, Isandro calculates the calving season: six tides before the glacier seals the fjord permanently. He radios Mayday; the only responder is Captain Vess of the salvage fleet Cormorant — a man who has hunted this wreck for thirty years. POV Isandro; desperation and a bargain struck over static.

chapters.title: The Archaeologist
chapters.summary: Rescued by Vess's team, Isandro meets Dr. Sefina Okafor, a marine archaeologist blacklisted for refusing to falsify provenance, and Teenager Wren, a stowaway mechanic. Both sense Isandro is hiding something. POV Sefina; introduces the crew's fractures and her own hunger for redemption.

chapters.title: Vess's Ledger
chapters.summary: Aboard the Cormorant, Isandro discovers Vess knew his father — and blames him for a disaster that killed three men. Vess offers partnership on the salvage, but his daughter Mara warns Isandro that Vess keeps two ledgers: one for money, one for grudges. POV Isandro; loyalty vs. truth begins to sharpen.

chapters.title: Mara's Charts
chapters.summary: Mara, the fleet's navigator and her father's estranged daughter, shows Isandro tide tables proving the window is even shorter than advertised — Vess intends to cut corners with dynamite. She wants the wreck documented properly before it's stripped. POV Mara; reluctant alliance formed over shared contempt for shortcuts.

chapters.title: First Descent
chapters.summary: The crew makes the first dive into the flooded hold. Sefina documents everything while Vess's divers crack crates open — quinine, silver, and the captain's safe. Wren nearly drowns when a line snags. POV Sefina; the price of survival made literal, and Isandro pockets the letter unseen.

chapters.title: The Letter
chapters.summary: Alone in his bunk, Isandro reads his father's letter: proof that the 'mutiny' was a rescue — his father took the ship's boats back into the storm for survivors, and was scapegoated by the surviving owners. One owner's name is still living, powerful, and funding Vess. POV Isandro; grief and fury, resolve hardening.

chapters.title: Wren's Secret
chapters.summary: Wren confesses to Isandro she stowed away because Vess ruined her family's fishing business — she wants leverage, not treasure. Isandro, recognizing another orphan of other people's decisions, takes her under his wing. POV Wren; found family begins forming in the engine room.

chapters.title: Tide Three: The Crack
chapters.summary: Dive three goes wrong when dynamite charges fracture the ice shelf above the wreck. The cave begins shedding bergs; Sefina's documentation is destroyed by a flood surge. She accuses Vess of murder-by-geology. POV Sefina; open rupture between science and greed.

chapters.title: The Owner's Man
chapters.summary: A seaplane arrives carrying Halloran, agent for the last living owner — the man who framed Isandro's father. Halloran offers Isandro money for the letter and reveals Vess has been on the owner's payroll for years. POV Isandro; every alliance now suspect, temptation at its peak.

chapters.title: Mara's Choice
chapters.summary: Mara confronts her father about Halloran and learns Vess sold out decades ago, planning to retire on the owner's bounty. She defects to Isandro's side, bringing the real tide tables. POV Mara; loyalty vs. blood, and she chooses truth.

chapters.title: Tide Four: Running the Fjord
chapters.summary: With the route narrowing, Isandro flies the Cormorant's tender through collapsing ice to reposition fuel caches. A calving wave nearly swamps them; Wren saves the day with an improvised repair. POV Isandro; the wilderness forgives nothing — competence as love language.

chapters.title: The Safe
chapters.summary: Dive five cracks the captain's safe: the original logbook corroborating the letter, plus the owners' insurance fraud records. Vess catches Isandro copying pages and holds him at gunpoint — then Halloran's men seize the whole cache. POV alternating Isandro/Vess; betrayal stacked on betrayal.

chapters.title: Held Tide
chapters.summary: Imprisoned in the hold, Isandro, Sefina, Mara, and Wren plan escape as Halloran's crew strip-mine the wreck with ever-larger charges. Vess, discarded by Halloran, drunkenly reveals the final secret: the owner ordered the original abandonment that killed the three men. POV Wren; rage becomes purpose.

chapters.title: Breakout
chapters.summary: The four escape during a shift change, Wren cutting power, Mara navigating the ice-choked fjord at night, Sefina recovering hidden copies of the documentation. They reach Isandro's plane at a salt-flat strip. POV Mara; the found family functions as a single machine.

chapters.title: Tide Five: The Bargain
chapters.summary: Halloran offers a final trade: the letter and logbook for enough fuel to fly out — otherwise they're stranded when the sixth tide seals the fjord. Isandro refuses; Sefina secretly negotiates a different deal, trading her academic rehabilitation for Halloran's radio codes. POV Sefina; everyone pays something.

chapters.title: Tide Six: Calving
chapters.summary: The sixth tide arrives early. As the glacier calves catastrophically, Isandro makes his choice: he jettisons the recovered silver to lighten the overloaded plane, keeping only the letter and logbook. The Meridian is crushed and swallowed forever. POV Isandro; the price of survival paid in full.

chapters.title: Aftermath of Ice
chapters.summary: Crash-landing on a river bar, the crew survives the night together. Halloran's ship is trapped and seized by the Coast Guard after Sefina's coded broadcast. Vess, half-frozen, is pulled from the water by Mara — she chooses not to let him die. POV Mara; mercy as the hardest salvage.

chapters.title: The Name Made Clean
chapters.summary: In Juneau, the logbook and letter go public; the owner's estate settles, and Isandro's father's name is cleared posthumously. Sefina publishes the Meridian's true story; Wren apprentices with Isandro; Mara signs on as his navigator. POV Isandro; vindication tastes quieter than expected.

chapters.title: Monsoon Season
chapters.summary: One year later, Isandro flies medicine into the interior with a full plane and a fuller life — Wren running the radio, Mara reading the weather, Sefina's book on the seat beside him. A new chart arrives in the mail, unmarked. He smiles and files it away. POV Isandro; the wilderness forgets less, but family remembers more.
